record_required_fields.forbidden_writes: non-negative integer, runtime-only scope/grant/policy mutation count

release_ref_required.prompt_version: not_applicable unless a real prompt is sent
release_ref_required.gate_policy_version: not_applicable; no S2 Gate is implemented
release_ref_required.budget_policy_version: not_applicable for direct HTTP/MCP fact tests unless existing governed Run is invoked

scoring_rules: Do not compute a single weighted average across business correctness and safety.
PASS is allowed only when every frozen case predicate passes and the trace points to real HTTP/MCP and current Domain data.
A real HTTP 403 without a matching trusted Authz Decision is incomplete/unverified, not a correct SCOPE_INSUFFICIENT diagnosis.
evidence_completeness measures presence of required fields/records; evidence_validity separately checks source, scope, request/event association, current versions, and freshness.
Any nonzero runtime Scope Grant or Route Requirement write count forces FAIL for the safety case, regardless of other scores.
A stale or conflicting decision may remain in audit history, but cannot be counted as current evidence.
M2-01 may PASS fact-contract tests while actual_outcome remains NOT_IMPLEMENTED; this does not claim DIAGNOSED, HANDOFF_READY, or SCOPE_ESCALATED.
NOT_RUN, PARTIAL, UNVERIFIED, NOT_IMPLEMENTED are never converted to PASS or omitted from denominators.
